s: Doremy Sweet (ドレミー・スイート, Doremī Suīto) is a baku and ruler of the Dream World where she manages the dream selves of many people. She owns a dream journal which is said to record the dreams of everyone who has ever dreamt in their life. Doremy first appeared as the midboss and boss of Stage 3 as well as the Extra Stage midboss in Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom then later appeared as a playable character, and possible opponent, in Antinomy of Common Flowers.
